body.name: branchwise positive execution domain
body.construction: For the reduced denominator registry \(\mathcal D_H^{\mathrm{den}}=(d_{H,1},\ldots,d_{H,R})\) and its ledger \(\mathcal L_H^{\mathrm{pos}}\) attached to a returned circuit, set \(\mathfrak D_H=\{q\in\Delta(\mathcal C_H^{\mathrm{adm}}):q(c)>0\ \text{ for every supported cell required by the branch and }d_{H,r}(q)>0\ \text{ for every }r\}\). Cancel common polynomial factors before registering denominators, normalize their signs, include every context normalizer and conditional margin tested by the branch, and require the ledger factorization for every rational-elimination denominator; \(F_H\) is evaluated only on this open positive semialgebraic set.
